descriptions.preferred: 由宾夕法尼亚州Green Mansions 苗圃的比利 · 施瓦兹发现的突变品种，并以比利施瓦兹的妈妈的名字命名。春天新叶为豆沙红色，夏季变为紫红色或青铜色，夏季的二次新稍和春叶一样，新老叶色彩对比明显，秋叶为橙色或者火红色。一般为 5-7 裂，叶裂深至基部，有明显的锯齿状边缘，生长速度较慢，矮生性，枝叶繁密，成年株可达 1.3m 左右高度。

rhs.description: An upright, compact deciduous shrub or small tree with feathery, lobed leaves. Leaves are dark green changing to bronze green flushed with pink in the spring, then red in the autumn. Flowers appearing in the spring are inconspicuous and are followed by winged, red seed pods in the summer.

attributes.suggested_uses: Architectural, City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Low Maintenance, Patio/Container Plants, Rock Garden
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this dwarf group are compact and slow-growing, making them ideal for pots and containers

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 由宾夕法尼亚州Green Mansions 苗圃的比利 · 施瓦兹发现的突变品种，并以比利施瓦兹的妈妈的名字命名。春天新叶为豆沙红色，夏季变为紫红色或青铜色，夏季的二次新稍和春叶一样，新老叶色彩对比明显，秋叶为橙色或者火红色。一般为 5-7 裂，叶裂深至基部，有明显的锯齿状边缘，生长速度较慢，矮生性，枝叶繁密，成年株可达 1.3m 左右高度。

attributes.hort_group_description: 这一矮生类群的 Acer 株形紧凑、生长缓慢，因此非常适合盆栽和容器栽培。
attributes.suggested_uses: 适合建筑感种植、城市/庭院花园、乡村式/自然式花园、低维护花园、露台/容器栽培及岩石园

care.propagation: 可采用嫁接或软枝扦插繁殖
care.cultivation: 宜栽培于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季必要时应补充浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴晒过度都可能导致叶缘焦枯。参见日本枫树栽培资料。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 直立、紧凑的落叶灌木或小乔木，叶片羽状、具裂片。叶色初为深绿色，春季转为带粉红晕染的铜绿色，秋季则变为红色。春季开花，不显著；夏季随后结出带翅的红色翅果。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Jerre Schwartz' Dwarf Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Jerre Schwartz' Jerre Schwartz Dwarf Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Jerre Schwartz' was found as witches' broom mutation by the famous Billy Schwartz. It is named after his mother, Jerre. This selection leafs out as a bright pink-red fading to a light green by mid-summer. The secondary flush of growth returns to a bright pink-red creating a dynamic contrast over the light green leaves. Fall colors are a bright oranges to fiery reds. Because of its witches' broom nature, it is extremely dense in habit. 'Jerre Schwartz' reaches 6 ft in height by 4 ft in width in 15 years making it a great Japanese maple for small spaces. It is ideal for conifer beds, rock gardens, miniature rail-road gardens, fairy gardens, and container growing.
